scope: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
book_order_policy: Exact Saints Holy Bible order and divisions from canon.json. Current source review follows its first 43 books: Law, Judgement, Wisdom and Providence. No additional books are inserted.
completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
verse_inventory_policy: Fully inventory each book from its declared edition before source review. Uninventoried pending books retain unknown verse and chapter counts. Fully inventoried pending books have known source totals and zero review credit until their initial curated review. Preserve nonstandard anchors, continuation units and original composite references.

runs.note: Initial setup batch: source edition, repository format, complete Genesis verse inventory and first chapter review established. This is 94 completed pairs, not a claim of 500 completed in an hour.
